codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly adds disallowedTools, mcpServers, and fork_eligible to the schema, updates prompt assembly to filter disallowed tools (with a logged warning) and scopes MCP tools appropriately. Test coverage is comprehensive.

issues.description: If an MCP tool is missing the mcp_server property (falsy), it bypasses the mcpServers scoping check and is included even if the agent defines an mcpServers list. Consider using `if (!server || !mcpServers.includes(server))` instead of `if (server && !mcpServers.includes(server))`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker did not read at least 2 existing agent files to understand frontmatter patterns as instructed in SKILL.md, but instead read AGENTS.md, services.yaml and tool-manifest.json. skillFeedback.followedProcedure is incorrectly true.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows no tool calls reading files like .claude/agents/*.md or similar, but shows reads to .factory/services.yaml and .claude/config/tool-manifest.json.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker needed to understand the MCP tools data structure and read .claude/config/tool-manifest.json to find the mcp_server field. This knowledge was required to implement mcpServers scoping correctly but wasn't documented in AGENTS.md.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows: 'Now let me check the tool manifest to understand the MCP tools data structure...' followed by a read to .claude/config/tool-manifest.json.

summary: Review of agent-schema-enhancements confirms all feature requirements were successfully implemented and tests cover the requirements. A minor edge case regarding missing mcp_server properties was noted. Some deviations from the SKILL.md procedure were found and documented as shared state gaps.
